title: ✨ What Feels Good Right Now: Sci-Fi Futures and Real World Joys
content:
Today we're hanging out in AskMetaFilter to get our dopamine hit for satisfaction and pleasure, figuratively and literally. 'Cause sometimes, you just want to feel something!

Looking for Sci-Fi That Hits a Little Too Close to Home? The post "Looking for science fiction that comments on what's happening right now" is a goldmine of dystopian, speculative, and all-too-real science fiction that explores everything from climate collapse to AI anxiety to societal change.

This is the perfect list of recommendations if you've ever finished the news and said, "Isn't this already a Black Mirror episode?"

What Brings You Real, Physical Pleasure? (No, Not LIke That–Well, Okay Maybe) Meanwhile, in a refreshingly human (aka real people, not AI) post, "What brings you real, physical pleasure", individuals are sharing their small, tactile joys—those moments that make your body sigh in contentment. In a time when everything is optimized and digitized, it's good to hear about real humans sharing what feels good in their bones, their skin, and their hearts.
author: Brandon Blatcher
